rationale: The entrypoint suite configures CODEBOOK_NUM=2 and CODEBOOK_SIZE=(4,4), while the real trainer uses those values to build the model; it then requires exported SID shape (8,3), so its expected output contradicts the configured run. The trainer also samples edge probabilities that sum to the number of source rows as if normalized globally, then overwrites only the final cumulative value with 1; this is not the frozen uniform-source/conditional-target estimator and can make cumulative probabilities non-monotone. Math oracles are independent, gradient tests use real RQVAE, and DDP spawns/gathers real ranks, but these do not cure the substantive mismatches.
